pros: Fast setup - minutes to a live dashboard.
Free registration and a demo account.
cons: Performance examples without dates or proof.
Asset list that shifts between pages.
The headline fee claim and the real cost disagree.
Two conflicting support figures.
redFlags: A support bullet that garbles two claims at once.
Performance language with no dates attached.
A broker relationship described in one vague sentence.

faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.
US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.
Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$250 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.

bottomLine: Brezzacapitivo is a standard-issue AI trading desk with the usual strengths and the usual omissions. None of the omissions are dealbreakers - they are conditions.

The score reflects the page: claims without verification, figures that conflict and restriction lists that disagree. Use the demo, deposit the minimum, and keep your own numbers - the page cannot be trusted with its own.
